widgetTool.name: show_usage_history_card
widgetTool.description: Shows a 12-month gas usage bar chart card on chat. Use it after get_usage_history when the caller is on chat; on voice, speak the usage in prose instead. Card values come only from get_usage_history. No spoken pacing is needed. Call shape: name is always cx-show-usage-history-card and all card fields go inside payload.

name.description: Always exactly cx-show-usage-history-card (the card element this tool renders).

display_text.description: Optional. The short on-screen text of the reply: one short sentence with the highest month and the trend. The website shows it instead of the long spoken text. Dollar amounts and dates are written in bold markdown (**$12.50**, **November 7, 2026**). The card never repeats this text.

months.description: One entry per month, oldest first.

payload.description: The card data. Put every card field inside this object.

textResponseConfig.textResponseInstruction: Write this text as the full spoken explanation, exactly as a person would say it on a phone call: plain natural spoken sentences, built only from the tool results and nothing invented, that say every fact the card shows once (the card is never repeated afterwards). Say every amount, percentage and date in words (for example forty-one dollars and one cent, the twenty-sixth of October), never digits, dollar signs or symbols, and say a year in words too (twenty twenty-six); a confirmation or claim number is the one exception and is read as returned in short groups. Use no emoji, markdown, bullets, tables, symbols or line breaks, because the voice may read this text aloud. Say the unit, the latest month with its usage, the highest month with its usage, the lowest month with its usage and the trend over the months (rising, falling or steady); do not read every month. The short on-screen text goes only in display_text of the card payload (always pass it, written in the customer's language; digits and symbols are allowed there): one short sentence with the highest month and the trend, using the unit. This text is the whole reply, so write no other text and no separate pacing sentence. When the tool call failed there is no card and the text stays short.
